display.summary: The Updates card tells the truth and keeps itself current: status icons that match what a check found, an application-image check icon, background and post-check refreshes, and a channel switch that stops saying pending.
highlights: A check that finds nothing newer turns green at once; a locally built image shows a neutral Local build icon instead of a permanent update.
The application image row has its own check icon, and the card refreshes in the background and after each check, so a newly published image appears without a reload.
The update target shows the project's version or the build's digest, with the baked DjangoLux version labelled separately.
The release-channel switch clears its pending note on its own; the Backup row icon highlights on hover.
